additional_info.subject: RE: ID0415585-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / PN 170001049] charging point is out of service CRM:02681000031
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
Please check Fuse FC5 and the power supply &
ethernet connection from meter to Switch and Switch to the PLC.
the outlet is not ready – the PLC has a communication error with the AC meter.
Please plan a site visit to check the meter ethernet connection to the switch and PLC ethernet connections to the switch.
Also please carry a spare tested ethernet cable and AC meter. AC Meter 3P 65A Direct Modbus TCP MID > 7KM2200-2EA40-1JA1
